title: Jack Rabbit Rio E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: As refreshing as it is moreish, Jack Rabbit’s bestselling Rio is a one-way ticket to tropical climes thanks to smooth coconut, tangy pineapple, fresh mango and tart papaya. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
